_schema.what: Named events with dates, for CHRONOLOGY (verify/chronology.py). A claim that names one of these references its date. Load-bearing on whether claims publish, so it carries the candidate-table discipline: a citable primary-source URL (verified by fetch, never typed from memory -- null until one is), and reviewed_by (null until a person checks the row).
_schema.rule: Any date a registry can answer is NOT in this table. The Lancet's 2010 retraction and the 2004 partial retraction ('retraction of an interpretation') of Wakefield 1998 resolve from Crossref update-to / Europe PMC commentCorrectionList on the source itself (verify/status.py) and are matched by verify/chronology.named_events from the registry's events, not from here.

columns.url: primary source, verified by fetch, or null

events.corroboration_note: Four-way agreement on the date: the Lancet retraction notice, the operator's hand-fetched copy, and two independently hosted copies fetched 2026-09-16. UNRESOLVED AND RULED IMMATERIAL BY THE REVIEWER: the operator's copy is 143 pp; the page length of the hosted copies could not be measured (the fetch converts to text and truncates, so no page count from it is a measurement). The reviewer ruled on 2026-09-16 that the discrepancy is immaterial to the conclusion, which is the date, and that the date is well enough supported by the documents in hand. The hosted filename 'gmc-charge-sheet.pdf' matches the operator's filename, which suggests but does not establish common provenance.

events.label: General Medical Council Fitness to Practise Panel determination on sanction: Wakefield's name to be erased from the medical register
events.source: GMC Fitness to Practise Panel, 'Determination on Serious Professional Misconduct and sanction', 24 May 2010. URL verified by fetch 2026-09-16. PRECISION: 24 May 2010 is the date the Panel DIRECTED erasure, not the date erasure took effect - the determination states erasure follows 28 days from formal notice absent appeal, and the document on file does not give that later date. The label was corrected on 2026-09-16 to say what the document says. A claim asserting erasure ON 2010-05-24 asserts more than this source supports.
events.curator: Claude Opus 5 on the operator's direction
